sections.title: Fixed
items: After a server restart, rewards and gold no longer stay switched off. Servers now keep trying until rewards work again.
Servers now use the current game service address instead of an old one.

sections.title: New
items: Army commanders can now pick extra commanders from their own side: one more for every 20 fighters on the roster, up to four commanders in total.
Pick them on the battle page until a few minutes before the battle starts, or during the battle with Esc → Commanders.
Extra commanders can use team pings, blow the war horn and see the team numbers. Their scoreboard row turns gold.
Extra commanders cannot call a retreat or pick other commanders.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: The Tent Kit is now called the Healing Tent, and the Cart Kit is now called the Forward Spawn, everywhere in battle.
On the spawn screen, the Base and Forward Spawn choice now sits right next to Autospawn.

sections.title: New
items: Hold Alt to see your team's tent and cart, with their health and how far away they are.
Aim at a tent or cart up close to see its health bar, in the same style as castle gates.
A deployed cart now flies your team's banner.
Base flags in campaign battles now show how many metres away they are.
The Stratlords lobby page has an eye button in the bottom left. Click it to hide the panels and enjoy the war council view, and click it again to bring them back.
Tavern music now plays while the Stratlords lobby page is open.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Tents and carts now show their damage as they get hit, so you can see when one is about to break.
Deploying a new tent or cart now replaces your team's old one, so you are never stuck carrying a kit you cannot use.
The Tent Kit and Cart Kit now look like crates you carry in both hands.
Carrying a Tent Kit or Cart Kit makes you 25% slower.
Menus and messages now say Stratlords instead of Strategus.

sections.title: New
items: Launcher 0.5.0 has a new look: castle art, one clear status and one big Play button. The newest update notes now show right on the main screen.
Installs and updates now show how many MB are done, the download speed and the time left.

sections.title: Fixed
items: If an update was cut off half-way, for example by a crash, the launcher now repairs it by itself next time you open it.
Very long game folder paths now install correctly.
The launcher's tooltips were blank; they are readable now.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: The launcher is now about 3 MB instead of 67 MB. It needs .NET Framework 4.8, which Windows normally already has. If yours does not, the launcher tells you where to get it.
After an update the launcher keeps only one backup of your old Warlords files, so it uses much less disk space.
Launcher 0.4.3 and 0.4.4 show an Update launcher button at the top. Older launchers: download the new Warlords.exe once from the website.
Battle cards now show a Steam sign-in message until you are signed in, then the Join buttons appear.

sections.title: New
items: To attack on the campaign map, your army now needs gear for at least 10% of its soldiers. Siege equipment does not count.

Soldiers now come from playing. Each 5 minutes on a team in campaign battles and sieges or on the Warlords Battle and Siege servers earns a ticket. Tickets turn into soldiers for your campaign army the next day, up to about 24 a day. You need a verified Steam link on your account page.
Gold you send to other players now shows in both players' gold history.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Sending companions or retainers to another player now counts toward your daily sending limit. Each one counts as 400 gold, so you can send 2 per day.
A fief can no longer be raided again right away. After a raid it is safe for 24 hours. Capturing a fief is still allowed.
Confirming an attack or siege no longer fails with an error.
Putting gold or gear into a clan-mate's fief now counts toward your daily sending limit, just like sending it to them directly. It also needs a verified Steam link. Your own fief is not affected.
An army that is chasing an enemy can no longer give away, sell or garrison its soldiers. Cancel the attack first.
Leaving a battle by disconnecting no longer saves your gear. It counts as a death.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Other players' armies now show rough sizes on the campaign map, like "~1,700 soldiers". Your own and your clan's armies stay exact.
Behind-the-scenes maintenance: the game files are now built from one place, which makes future updates more reliable. Nothing changes in game.
Fiefs earn twice as much gold: towns 360, castles 160, villages 80.
The servers now show their public names: Warlords EU Lobby 1, Warlords EU Battle, Warlords EU Siege and Warlords EU Clan War 1 to 3.
Standing still in a battle for about 2 minutes stops your playtime from counting.
Free-for-all servers no longer earn tickets.
Caravans, town work, sending gifts and buying soldiers need a Steam link that is at least 3 days old.
You can send other players at most 1,000 gold worth of gold, soldiers and gear per day, and nothing at all while an enemy army is chasing you.
Attacks need at least 20 soldiers. Skipping your own attack costs at least a fifth of your army.
Raids take 30% of a fief's treasury instead of 50%. Fiefs can only be given to your own clan, once a week.
Officers can take at most 2,000 gold a day from clan fiefs, and the fief owner is told.
Big trade loads keep slowing your army, and grouped armies move at the speed their full size allows.
Coming next: bought soldiers will cost 40 gold, gear will cost a bit more and sell back for half price, caravans will earn less, and very large armies will pay a small daily upkeep.
The DEV test build is now version 1.1.2. Update once through Warlords.exe to keep joining the servers.

sections.title: Activated
items: Warlords is open to everyone. You no longer need to be on the tester list to play.
Get the game with the Warlords launcher from stratlords.online. Still have the old Steam Workshop Warlords? The launcher shows a "Remove old Workshop copy" button. Press it and unsubscribe in Steam.
Attacks, sieges and village raids are back on in the campaign. Battles are booked at least a day ahead.
The new prices are live now. Bought soldiers cost 40 gold.
Gear and horses cost about half again as much, and everything sells back for half its price. That includes ladders, tents and carts.
Caravans earn 35 gold per stop instead of 75.
Armies with more than 50 soldiers pay half a gold per extra soldier each day, starting tomorrow. If you can't pay, some of the extra soldiers leave.
Playtime tickets now count on the Dev Warlords Battle and Siege servers and in campaign battles and sieges.

sections.title: New
items: Coming soon to campaign battles: Tent Kits and Cart Kits. Your army will buy them in town markets next to the ladders, and any soldier can carry one into battle. They are not for sale yet.
A deployed tent slowly heals your teammates standing near it, up to 90% health.
A deployed cart becomes a forward spawn point for your team. Pick Base or Cart on the spawn screen. You can't spawn there while enemies are close, and a cart must stay well away from the enemy base.
Each team can have one tent and one cart standing at a time, and enemies can destroy them. Press B to place one (you can change the key in the options).

sections.title: Adjusted
items: The DEV test build is now version 1.1.1. Update once through Warlords.exe to keep joining the servers.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Maintenance only, no game changes: update notes like this one now post more reliably. Two earlier notes got stuck and will follow in a separate post.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Missed notes from November 3: DEV testers got a Clan Battle server ("Dev Warlords Clan Battle"). It shows under Clan Wars.
DEV testers also got a Siege server ("Dev Warlords Siege", 250 players) and two more Clan Battle servers (100 players each).
The DEV lobby now holds up to 1000 players and the DEV battle server up to 100.
These have not been tried in a real game yet.
